method: Full pinned source read in three contiguous ranges; Git blob verified. Original rm_directory_equal compiled with synthetic digest/set adapters and XOR-populated directory summaries. No complete scanner execution.
findings: Counting pass marks FTS_ERR and FTS_DC as errors and propagates -1 upward, but ignores FTS_DNR and continues after failed fallback stat without adding an error marker. fts_read termination is not checked for errno. This is separate from previously reviewed primary traversal behavior.

Directory admission requires positive counted file total equal to admitted duplicate count. Count-tree values use int/pointer conversions despite 64-bit directory count fields; parent lookup uses unsigned conversion, so an error sentinel -1 becomes a large positive value.

Directory equality checks duplicate count, cumulative XOR digest, distinct digest-set size and membership, not per-digest multiplicities. Without layout hashing, summaries of A,A,A,B and A,B,B,B are indistinguishable under this comparator. End-to-end impact still needs scanner reproduction.

Layout option additionally hashes basename plus digest and recursively includes child name/digest in cumulative summary, but equality still has no exact structural comparison. Default explicitly ignores paths and layout.
Counting failure causes rm_tm_new to return null after allocating tables/tries without local cleanup. Count pass failure path also omits destruction of initialized file_tree.

Output callback return value is ignored; directory metadata is captured at construction and no final recursive content revalidation occurs in this file. Aborted state prevents extraction, but cluster-up loop itself has no abort check.

executed_control.scope: Original comparator with synthetic set/digest adapters. Does not execute actual file hashing, traversal or scanner grouping.

limits: Potential multiset and traversal issues are not claimed as full-program reproductions.
